scripts.build: pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-core run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-sdk run lint && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-core run lint && eslint "packages/workspace-sdk/src/**/*.ts" "packages/platform-core/src/**/*.ts" --ignore-pattern "**/*.spec.ts"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-sdk run test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-core run test
scripts.phase-0:gate: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm run guard:architecture && pnpm run guard:import-boundary && pnpm run phase-0:guard && pnpm run baseline:metrics
scripts.phase-1:gate: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm run guard:architecture && pnpm run guard:import-boundary && pnpm run guard:symlink && pnpm run phase-1:guard
